eras.note: 13 districts in the Yakima Valley area were redrawn under a 2024-03-15 federal court remedial order (Soto Palmer v. Hobbs); first used under the revised lines in 2024. House and Senate share identical district boundaries. Veto override is 2/3 of members present, not full elected membership — the seat figure here assumes full attendance.
